name: D-apiitol to nitrate
summary: A 16-step route from D-apiitol to nitrate, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.equation: N(2)-(2-carboxyethyl)-L-arginine + ATP = deoxyamidinoproclavaminate + AMP + diphosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: clavaminate synthase
reactions.equation: proclavaminate + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = dihydroclavaminate + succinate + CO2 + H2O

reactions.name: clavaminate synthase
reactions.equation: dihydroclavaminate + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = clavaminate + succinate + CO2 + H2O

reactions.name: nitrate reductase [NAD(P)H]
reactions.equation: nitrite + NADP(+) + H2O = nitrate + NADPH + H(+)

reactions.name: ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl-diphosphate synthase [(2E,6E)-farnesyl-
reactions.equation: 8 isopentenyl diphosphate + (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate = di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + 8 diphosphate

reactions.name: 4-nitrophenol 4-monooxygenase
reactions.equation: 4-nitrophenol + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = 1,4-benzoquinone + nitrite + NADP(+) + H2O

reactions.name: hydroxylamine dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: hydroxylamine + 4 Fe(III)-[cytochrome c] + H2O = 4 Fe(II)-[cytochrome c] + nitrite + 5 H(+)

reactions.name: D-octopine dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: D-octopine + NAD(+) + H2O = L-arginine + pyruvate + NADH + H(+)

reactions.name: hexaprenyl diphosphate synthase [geranylgeranyl-diphosphate specific]
reactions.equation: 2 isopentenyl diphosphate + (2E,6E,10E)-geranylgeranyl diphosphate = all-trans-hexaprenyl diphosphate + 2 diphosphate
